title: Concave and Convex Mirrors
summary: Curved mirrors can magnify, shrink or flip images. Explore torches, shaving mirrors and rear-view mirrors.

ib.note: Mirror equation and sign conventions are CBSE Class 10 / MYP 5

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 10: Light: Mirrors and Lenses

objectives: I can distinguish concave and convex mirrors and describe their images.
I can use a ray diagram to find the image formed by a concave mirror for different object positions.
I can explain everyday uses of concave and convex mirrors.
misconceptions: Curved mirrors always make things bigger.
A convex mirror can form a real image.
The focus is where the object must be placed.
